node.text: My app is thriving. I see ten thousand people using something I created, and I have the freedom to work by the ocean with my family. The work is meaningful, and there is room to enjoy the life around it.
A visual goal setting system to help you see it, reinforce it, and move toward what matters.

node.content-desc: Give what matters a shape., Anchor turns an intention into a visual you can return to, reinforce, and act on.
An intention is handwritten in a notebook, breaks into fragments, and those fragments build an example Anchor symbol.
